title: Biocompatibility and biodegradation of a native porcine pericardium membrane: results of in vitro and in vivo examinations
authors: Rothamel D, Schwarz F, Fienitz T, Smeets R, Dreiseidler T, Ritter L, Happe A, Zöller J. Int J Oral Maxillofac Implants. 2012 Jan-Feb;27(1):146-54.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Both examined membranes indicate a high level of biocompatibility. Both are resorbed without inflammation within 8 weeks (Bio -Gide) or 12 weeks (Remotis). The compact interco nnective pericardium collagen of Remotis may have stabilized the resorption process” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
